propositions: rebar comment and related positional-body commands accept flag-looking tokens (e.g. --body-file, --body) as the body argument instead of rejecting them, silently discarding the intended content and exiting 0
A value beginning with `-` can be passed safely using `--` as an escape hatch (e.g. `rebar comment <id> -- "-starts with dash"`)

All positional-body commands (comment, tag, untag, archive, set-verify-commands, create, edit, session-log) enforce consistent validation via a command table, rejecting flag-like bodies with non-zero exit and usage message
Surplus positional arguments are no longer silently truncated when a flag-like token is mistakenly provided as the body
Test coverage explicitly asserts rejection of --body-file and --body forms and validates the -- escape hatch on comment and tag paths
